evidence.statement: The room request field is renamed to channelId.
The text request field is renamed to content.

An explicit notify boolean maps to notification.enabled. When notify is undefined, notification must be omitted. Notification behavior for omitted values can vary by account policy and equivalence is unresolved.
The message_id response field is renamed to id.
The created_at response field is renamed to createdAt.
Node.js 18 is no longer supported; the fixture target is Node.js 22.
